information.description:
Patrol Officers are the tougher version of a Beat Cop. They’ve got experience and are some of the most common NCPD badges you’ll encounter in Night City. Patrol Officers are often better armed than their beat cop comrades, but not devastatingly so.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Ncpd).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

Once upon a time, in the second half of the 20th century, the world's most popular assault rifle was the AK-47 – also commonly known as the Kalashnikov, in honor of its inventor. Today, these rifles can only be found in museums as their market niche was replaced by the Nokota Copperhead. This mass-produced assault rifle sticks to the basics of functionality and reliability. There's no finesse or ingenuity to fall in love with, but many people find its dependable stopping power endearing.

Cost: 350eb (Expensive)

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

The preferred pistol among Night City cops – light, wieldy, and easy on the recoil, it's perfect for taking down enemies without necessarily killing them on the spot. Thanks to its relatively small dimensions, the gun has also found a loyal following among those who prefer a concealed carry: the Lexington easily fits in a coat pocket or purse. And for design lovers, its classic 2030s frame remains stunning as ever.

Special Features: If any damage dealt by this weapon would reduce a target to under 1 HP, they are instead Unconscious at 1 HP.
